sections.heading: Equip your Essence
sections.body: Absorbing an Essence adds it to your Soul Archive. Select your First Hunt Essence and equip it in a loadout so it can take part in combat. Slot changes save automatically.

sections.heading: Choose your first equipment
sections.body: After attuning your First Hunt Essence, open Equipment & Forge and choose your starter hands and armor. Equip the complete kit from Inventory. First Weapon then awards Scrap and your band, amulet and vial; equip those accessories to prepare for Lumo Ruins.

sections.heading: Follow the Quest Journal
sections.body: The journal shows your next objective and where to complete it. Spending resources at the Forge is optional for these first steps.
